Let me verify how the installed plugin relates to the local repo (this determines the rollout path):

[tool-call run_code] {"code": "
const t = (x: any) => x.kind === "foreground" ? (x.stdout.text + (x.stderr.text || "")) : JSON.stringify(x);
const A = "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\profiles\\desktop\\node_modules\\dsh-our-free-model";
const B = "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\Desktop\\github\\dsh-our-free-model";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: `
$f1 = Get-Item '${A}\\client.js'
$f2 = Get-Item '${B}\\client.js'
"installed client.js : $($f1.Length) bytes LinkType=$($f1.LinkType) Target=$($f1.Target)"
"repo client.js : $($f2.Length) bytes LinkType=$($f2.LinkType)"
"installed index.js : $((Get-Item '${A}\\index.js').Length)"
"repo index.js : $((Get-Item '${B}\\index.js').Length)"
'--- fsutil hardlink list ---'
fsutil hardlink list '${A}\\client.js'
'--- version installed ---'
(Get-Content -Raw '${A}\\package.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).version
'--- version repo ---'
(Get-Content -Raw '${B}\\package.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).version
'--- .plugin-manager ---'
Get-ChildItem -Force 'C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\profiles\\desktop\\.plugin-manager' -Recurse -Depth 2 | Select-Object -First 30 FullName | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 250
`, description: "Compare installed plugin with repo and check hardlinks" });
console.log(t(r).slice(0, 4000));
